uk_legal_risk.reason: The acquisition advice relies partly on cold social DMs to business owners and local tradespeople, which can reach individuals or sole traders; under the supplied UK filter, those unsolicited DMs are banned. Cold email is limited to limited companies with an opt-out.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Check rights and consent for identifiable likenesses or voices and avoid misleading synthetic endorsements. Cold calls should be screened against TPS/CTPS.
